description: A coalition of EU member states successfully launches a joint, real-time audit framework for high-risk AI systems in critical infrastructure, leveraging ASML's supply-chain leverage to demand transparency from American providers. This marks the first coordinated institutional pushback against opaque frontier models, driven by the summer's cyber intrusion and the AI Act's deferred enforcement. The initiative gains traction rapidly as smaller states see it as a way to reclaim agency without direct confrontation.
